sources.snippet: Minima Minima is a W1.58A8 release candidate converted from LiquidAI/LFM2.5-Encoder-350M for fast, low-memory CPU inference and fused CUDA kernel research without losing its 8,192-token context. It includes packed kernels, quantization-aware distillation, recovery adapters, task-tuning tools, and a spellchecker reference fine-tune.

sources.snippet: NeuSpell is an open-source toolkit for context sensitive spelling correction in English. This toolkit comprises of 10 spell checkers, with evaluations on naturally occurring mis-spellings from multiple (publicly available) sources. sources.title: Spelling Correction in Text Preprocessing Using SymSpell
sources.snippet: Proper spelling correction improves the quality of preprocessing and increases model accuracy. Introduction to SymSpell The SymSpell Python library is built for fast and accurate spelling correction. It uses a novel algorithm that leverages precomputed dictionaries and phonetic similarity to suggest correct spellings.
